description: APPROACH A v2: symbolic χ^λ via canonical hoefsmit_symbolic + Markov-trace half-symmetric projection at the Borromean braid (σ_1 σ_2^{-1})^3. Extracts c_4, c_6 in closed form via sympy.series at q=1+ε.

structural_finding.interpretation: The canonical Markov trace τ_M(β_Bor) does NOT equal the conjecture's λ_scale at the Borromean braid. At q=1, τ_M(β_Bor) = 5/3 (Plancherel sum of χ²/n!), not 5/2 (half-symmetric conjugate-pair count). This means the conjecture's '5/2 - h²·G' is NOT the Markov trace of the Borromean braid — it's a DIFFERENT categorical projection involving the half-symmetric Wedderburn weighting derived in Step 2 of the proof. The h^4 coefficient c_4 must come from THAT projection's expansion, not from the canonical Markov trace.
structural_finding.next_step: Define the half-symmetric projection π_HS explicitly: π_HS(τ) = Σ over conjugate pairs (χ_λ + χ_λ') with weight 1, plus self-conjugate χ_λ with weight 1/2 (no normalisation by [n]_q!). Apply to χ^λ(β_Bor) and expand in h.
